newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates unchanged amid dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates unchanged amid dull trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were unchanged on Monday amid dull trading and dealers said demand from mills was likely to remain sluggish.

"There was little activity today as market players were busy in watching the oath-taking ceremony of new Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif and the National Assembly session," dealer Khushi Ram said. "Mill owners, who built positions in December, are expected to start fresh buying towards the end of February."
In the kerb, NIAB-78 was quoted between 2,050 ($50.96) to 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and K-68 at 2,300 rupees.
